meta.note:
Note:
1. The above data includes the total annuity cases processed and uploaded in CRA portals.

Option A – Annuity for life
Option B – Annuity for life with Return of Purchase Price
Option C – Joint Life Annuity
Option D – Joint Life Annuity with Return of Purchase Price
Option E – NPS - Family Income Option
Option F – Life Annuity with Return of Premium/Purchase Price in parts
Option G – Life Annuity with Return of Premium/Purchase Price on diagnosis of Critical Illness

2. Annuity Scheme Option "Others" includes annuity schemes offered by ASPs other than the five standard annuity schemes.
